searchText: <@!203220829473996800> you mentioned that you abandoned carousel and DHT approaches for some things. I'm curious if you could provide a synopsis of why you dropped those avenues of research. The carousel approach is particularly interesting to me and I'd like to avoid duplicating effort if there's a fundamental flaw that I'm not aware of. Not entirely dropped, it's still similar to a carousel. Just with some twists, and Eth2 shards focused. Will share more publicly if it passes review, I don't want to create noise with failing ideas.
